items.title: Bitcoin ETFs are bleeding cash and the Fed is unlikely to help
Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend
items.summary: The Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust drew $114.1 million in monthly net inflows through Wednesday, while US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $5.39 billion.

items.title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
items.summary: The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.

items.title: Europe’s only spot bitcoin ETF starts trading in Switzerland, BIT says
items.summary: BIT Asset Management's BBIT fund debuted on SIX Swiss Exchange with 350 BTC in assets and a 0.19% annual expense ratio.
